title: Interstellar Civilization Risk Simulator - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Models mission failures, resource scarcity, communication loss, and resilience in isolated settlements.
body:
Known science foundations of Interstellar Civilization Risk Simulator.

Probabilistic risk assessment is mature (nuclear, aerospace). Settlement studies model life-support failure. The inputs for interstellar settlements — failure rates, scarcity dynamics — are guesses. The simulator is useful for exploring assumptions, not predicting outcomes.

Key quantity check (Mission failure modes modeled / validated against real missions): computed ratio 5 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Interstellar Civilization Risk Simulator.

No data on interstellar settlement failures. Assumptions dominate outputs. Resilience strategies are untested.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 1.3 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is modes modeled vs settlements simulated at 1.3 orders of magnitude (modes modeled larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
